payload.title: Edit a Reference or Story from its conversation card
payload.description:
Feature: Act from Papyrus cards
Scenario: A card and a chat instruction call the same operation
  Given a signed-in editor can curate a reference
  When the editor acts on its card or instructs their agent to act
  Then the same curation operation applies and shows the updated record
Scenario: A displayed decision is stale
  Given someone changed a reference since the card was displayed
  When the editor submits a decision against the displayed version
  Then the card requests a refresh without replacing the newer decision
